from pathlib import Path
import re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import Counter
roots=[Path('app'),Path('core'),Path('feature')]
files=[]
for root in roots:
    if root.exists(): files += [p for p in root.rglob('*.kt') if 'build' not in p.parts]
print('KOTLIN_FILE_COUNT='+str(len(files)))
print('KOTLIN_TOTAL_LOC='+str(sum(len(p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()) for p in files)))
rows=[]
suppression_rules=Counter()
for p in files:
    text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    lines=text.splitlines()
    fn=len(re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*(?:public\s+|private\s+|internal\s+|protected\s+|override\s+|suspend\s+|inline\s+|operator\s+|infix\s+|tailrec\s+)*fun\s+',text))
    types=len(re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*(?:(?:data|sealed|enum|annotation|value)\s+)?(?:class|interface|object)\s+',text))
    suppresss=re.findall(r'@(?:file:)?Suppress\((.*?)\)',text,re.S)
    for block in suppresss:
        for rule in re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"',block): suppression_rules[rule]+=1
    rows.append((len(lines),fn,types,len(suppresss),str(p)))
print('TOP_PRODUCTION_FILES')
for loc,fn,ty,sup,p in sorted(rows,reverse=True):
    if '/test/' in p or '/androidTest/' in p or '/src/test/' in p: continue
    print(f'{loc:5d} LOC | {fn:3d} fun | {ty:3d} types | {sup:2d} suppress-blocks | {p}')
    if sum(1 for q in sorted(rows,reverse=True) if q[4]==p)==0: pass
# Print only top 35 production files without shell head/SIGPIPE.
prod=[r for r in sorted(rows,reverse=True) if '/test/' not in r[4] and '/androidTest/' not in r[4] and '/src/test/' not in r[4]]
print('TOP35_PRODUCTION_FILES_COMPACT')
for loc,fn,ty,sup,p in prod[:35]: print(f'{loc}|{fn}|{ty}|{sup}|{p}')
print('SUPPRESSION_RULE_COUNTS')
for k,v in suppression_rules.most_common(30): print(f'{k}={v}')
ids=Counter(); total=0; baseline_files=[]
for p in Path('.').rglob('detekt-baseline.xml'):
    if 'build' in p.parts: continue
    baseline_files.append(p)
    try: root=ET.parse(p).getroot()
    except Exception as e:
        print('BASELINE_PARSE_ERROR',p,e); continue
    for el in root.iter():
        if el.tag.endswith('ID') and el.text:
            ids[el.text.split(':',1)[0]]+=1; total+=1
print('DETEKT_BASELINE_FILES='+str(len(baseline_files)))
print('DETEKT_BASELINE_ENTRIES='+str(total))
print('DETEKT_BASELINE_TOP_RULES')
for k,v in ids.most_common(30): print(f'{k}={v}')
PY
